title: AE40028: Rocket Propulsion
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE31001
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsClassification of rocket motors
and their distinctive features; Ideal nozzle theory; Departures from ideal
conditions; Adiabatic flame temperature; Frozen and equilibrium flows; Heat
transfer in rocket engines; Liquid propellant rocket motors and its design and
performance; Solid propellant rocket motors and its design and performance;
Combustion instability External ballistics Rocket testing.
